recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game titled `Neon Ring Rush: Loop Breaker`. It is a one-button Sonic-inspired high-speed runner platformer. The player is a blue quilled speedster fixed near the left side of a scrolling neon loopway. Tap/click to jump only when grounded. Gravity returns the runner to the track. Pink wheeled badnik hazards scroll from right to left. If the player is falling and above a badnik, the badnik is stomped, the player bounces, and rings are awarded; otherwise contact causes a wipeout. Rings increase continuously with bonus bursts on stomps. At a distance threshold, an Egg Core boss appears, fires arcing plasma shots, descends into a vulnerable window, and must be stomped three times from above to win. Preserve those mechanics exactly. Use procedural Canvas art, neon loop arcs, cyan/pink/gold palette roles, Bangers/Orbitron/Rajdhani typography, compact mobile HUD, and touch-friendly overlays.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is an inline Canvas auto-runner platformer. The player controls a circular runner fixed near the left side of the screen. Tapping/clicking during active states triggers a single jump if grounded. Gravity pulls the runner back to a ground plane. Enemies scroll from right to left; falling onto an enemy from above destroys it, bounces the player, and awards score, while any other contact causes game over. Score increments continuously. After a distance threshold, a hovering boss appears, fires arcing projectiles, descends into a vulnerable window, and requires three falling stomps to defeat. Victory adds a large score bonus and shows a win overlay. Restart resets the run.

## Protected mechanics
- One-button jump input during active gameplay only.
- Gravity, grounded state, jump force, landing, and spin/run animation semantics.
- Autoscrolling enemy hazards, random spawn chance, and off-screen cleanup.
- Stomp-vs-body collision semantics for enemies.
- Score over time plus stomp/victory bonuses.
- Boss trigger by distance, projectile arcs, vulnerability window, three boss hits, victory, game over, and restart.

## Safe theming surfaces
- Title, HUD terms, panel copy, typography, colors, particles, background, entity drawing, audio cue selection, GIF feedback, and procedural motifs.

## Rebuilt target
`Neon Ring Rush: Loop Breaker` is a Sonic-inspired mobile portrait runner where the same one-button timing loop is reframed as ring rushing through a neon loopway, stomping badniks, and cracking an Egg Core.
